contract: A23-79 server: Fx PauseCard { Why Chapter|Daily|War, Next = the pinned row's short name, Zone = a Travel destination I may enter (Home for my town, none for the other side's / a gated zone, seasonal -> meadow), Tomorrow (daily: the King Diary page while one waits), OptIn? } 1.5 s after a chapter's last main quest / the day's last daily claim / a war round I scored in after 15 min of play (one war card in 30 min), 120 s apart, waits out a fight; Fx WelcomeBack { Next, Zone } 4 s after a join 6 h+ after the last leave (first mission done); attribute MyWay from the story picks (2+ picks, a fifth = Balance Walker, Halo True Knight / Rebel Angel, Horns Proud Rascal / Soft-Hearted Devil, Neutral none); 8 badges via BadgeService (id 0 never asked, saved once, failures retried after 300 s, caught up at join); the opt-in moment once (10 min played, 60 s after a KO / failed scroll / purchase prompt, 'cannot' again after 30 days, a shown prompt -> the asked DataStore list); invite joins from LaunchData (digits, not mine, the first kept) + PlayedTogether at 10 minutes; GoToFriend(userId): ready, 3 s, a friend / invite pair here, PvP zones only from Lv15, never the other town, ZoneService.Travel with the channel; King Diary pages per king beaten together up to today's page in the season, page 9 title once; candy jar titles for candy, after the season too.
limitations: The cards / book / jar windows and the opt-in prompt are client work (game dev 1; PauseCard.luau exists). BadgeService ids are made by the user at publishing. The real QuestService / StoryQuestService / WarService / HalloweenService run in their own suites; here their new signals are doubles (static checks cover the hooks).
